_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPControlsCycleControlsHelp: Lets you switch between prompts from different mods. When disabled, a new mod's prompts replace the previous set.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPControlsMaxButtonsHelp: Maximum number of prompts shown at once. In List layout, additional prompts can be scrolled into view.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPControlsNavigationModifierH: Hold this button and use the left stick or trackpad. Up/down selects prompts; left/right switches between mods.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectClockwiseHelp: Fill the progress arc clockwise. Turn off to fill counterclockwise.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectColorHelp: Color and transparency of this part of the effect.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectHoldSizeHelp: Multiply the hold marker's size. 1 keeps its normal size.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectIndicatorSizeHelp: Multiply the list arrows' size. 1 keeps their normal size.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectIndicatorSpacingHelp: Extra space between each arrow and the visible list, in screen pixels.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectOffsetXHelp: Shift this effect horizontally in screen pixels. Positive values move it right.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectOffsetYHelp: Shift this effect vertically in screen pixels. Positive values move it down.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectPopDurationHelp: Length of the activation pop, in seconds.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectPopIconOnlyHelp: Animate only the button icon, without the text.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectPopOpacityHelp: Starting opacity of the expanding copy, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque).
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectPopScaleHelp: Final scale of the expanding copy. 1 keeps its original size.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectRadiusHelp: Multiply the progress circle's radius. 1 keeps its normal size.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectRotationHelp: Rotate the circle's starting point and markers, in degrees. Positive values rotate clockwise.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectShowArcHelp: Draw the arc that fills as an action is held.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectShowCommandsHelp: Draw the remove and skip marks when their special commands are available.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectShowHoldHelp: Draw the marker for hold actions.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectShowIndicatorsHelp: Show arrows when more list prompts are hidden above or below.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectShowTrackHelp: Draw the faint full circle behind the progress arc.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPEffectThicknessHelp: Multiply the width of the circle's lines. 1 keeps their normal thickness.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPSettingsFadeSpeedHelp: How quickly prompts fade in and out. Higher values make the fade faster.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPSettingsIcon2FontRatioHelp: Icon size relative to the text size. 1 uses the same size.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPSettingsLifetimeHelp: Time in seconds before prompts start fading out.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPSettingsLineSpacingHelp: Extra spacing between prompts, relative to the text size.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPSettingsMarginXHelp: Horizontal offset in resolution-scaled pixels. Positive moves left; negative moves right.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPSettingsMarginYHelp: Vertical offset in resolution-scaled pixels. Positive moves up; negative moves down.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPSettingsProgressSpeedHelp: How quickly a held button fills its progress indicator. Higher values require a shorter hold.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPSettingsPromptPivotHelp: Which point of the prompt group is placed at the configured position.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPSettingsPromptSizeHelp: Text size in resolution-scaled pixels. Icons scale with it.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPSettingsXPercentHelp: Horizontal screen position: 0 is the left edge, 1 is the right edge.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPSettingsYPercentHelp: Vertical screen position: 0 is the top edge, 1 is the bottom edge.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPSpecialCommandsHelp: Double press: delete current prompt\nTriple press: cycle through prompts\nTriple press and hold: delete all prompts
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPSpecialCommandsResponsivene: Higher values gives you less time to press the next key in return for faster response
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPThemeBackgroundColorHelp: Color and transparency of the text background.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPThemeBackgroundPaddingHelp: Extra space on each side of the text, in screen pixels. Negative values shrink the background.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPThemeBackgroundRadiusHelp: Corner radius in screen pixels. Zero or negative values give square corners.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPThemeExportFailed: Failed to export the theme. Check SkyPrompt.log.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPThemeExportHelp: Exports the current settings to a theme file.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPThemeExportInvalid: The filename is invalid on Windows.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPThemeFontShadowHelp: Opacity of the text shadow: 0 hides it, 1 makes it fully opaque.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPThemeSaveFailed: Failed to save the theme. Check SkyPrompt.log.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPThemeSpecialFloatHelp: Value supplied to the theme's special effect. Its meaning depends on the effect.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptMCPThemeSpecialIntegerHelp: Value supplied to the theme's special effect. Use the color picker only when the effect expects a color.
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptTutorialDelete: Delete Me: Double Press the Button!
line:menu_translation/skyprompt:SkyPromp.$SkyPromptTutorialDeleteAll: Delete All: Triple Press and Hold the Button!
